comment: Independent C-first controlled teleport onto the hero's wished ICE square. The input follows source-observed read-scroll and controlled-destination More boundaries, then Escape closes C's first-use TIP_GETPOS/Farlooking window and '.' selects getpos's initial cursor on the current ICE square. This exercises scrolltele -> teleds -> spoteffects(TRUE) at the accepted same-square destination without a JS-selected input.
